items.title: Improved Android compatibility
items.description: Resolved a sign-in-screen error affecting certain older Android WebView versions; sign-in stays within the app.

items.title: Clearer latency indicators
items.description: Ping badges now use readable light-theme backgrounds while preserving the fast, moderate and slow color meanings.

items.title: Green connected-state feedback
items.description: The Connect button turns green after a successful VPN connection, regardless of theme or accent color.
